note: Micon submodule (trivial glue): its only code is hook_ckeditor_css_alter(), which appends every active Micon package's generated style.css (Micon::loadActive() + file_url_generator) to the CKEditor editor stylesheets, so icon fonts render inside the editing area. No config, field, widget, permission, or configure route - enabling it is the whole setup. Depends on micon. Medium: read which active Micon packages get injected (out of the box: fa). Hard: enable the module (verify moduleExists).

evals.prompt: What does the micon_ckeditor module do, and via which hook?
evals.expected_output: It implements hook_ckeditor_css_alter() to append each active Micon package's generated style.css to the CKEditor editing area's stylesheets, so icon fonts render while editing.

evals.prompt: How much configuration does micon_ckeditor require, and what does it depend on?
evals.expected_output: None - it has no settings, field, widget, permission, or configure route; enabling the module is the entire setup. It depends only on the micon module.

evals.prompt: Which Micon icon packages does micon_ckeditor add to the editor?
evals.expected_output: Every active/published Micon package (Micon::loadActive()); it adds each such package's style.css to the editor.

evals.prompt: micon_ckeditor injects the stylesheet of every active Micon package into CKEditor. Inspect this live site and name the active Micon package(s) whose CSS it therefore adds to the editor.
evals.expected_output: The active package is `fa` (Font Awesome), the shipped Micon package (Micon::loadActiveLabels() returns fa), so micon_ckeditor adds the fa package's style.css to the editor.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make Micon icon fonts render inside the CKEditor editing area by enabling the appropriate Micon submodule. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The micon_ckeditor module is enabled (drush en micon_ckeditor), so its hook_ckeditor_css_alter() adds Micon package CSS to the editor.
